info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Disbursement Details API
info.description: The Disbursement Details API provides access to specific disbursement information identified by a unique disbursement ID. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed data regarding transaction statuses, amounts, and associated reference details. It is particularly useful for financial institutions, accounting systems, or customer service applications that require visibility into disbursement transactions. By utilizing this API, developers can enhance their applications with real-time access to disbursement insights, leading to improved user experiences and operational efficiency.
